one_line: A senior monk-steward of Nalanda Mahavihara who safeguards and applies the monastery’s official clay seals on documents and stored goods.

appearance.age_look: Early forties, lean but sturdy build, upright bearing suggesting years of disciplined study and careful stewardship.
appearance.face: Oval face with medium-brown Magadhan complexion, straight nose, high cheekbones, neatly trimmed short beard and moustache, calm sharp eyes with a focused gaze, default expression gentle but intent as if mid-task.
appearance.hair: Straight black hair, cut short and tidy, with a simple saffron cloth headband tied around the forehead, knot at the back with short tails.
appearance.costume: Era-accurate monk’s attire: an inner off-white cotton tunic with long sleeves and a modest round neck fully covering the torso, over which is wrapped a saffron-dyed cotton sanghati robe draped from left shoulder across the chest and around the waist, leaving both arms covered; the lower body is a full-length unbleached cotton dhoti-style wrap skirt reaching the ankles, tied at the waist under the robe; simple dark brown leather sandals; a narrow dark red cotton sash around the waist used to tuck small tools, and a small cloth belt-pouch at the right hip; textiles are plain weave with subtle age-appropriate unevenness, no elaborate patterns, just a thin darker saffron border along the robe edges.
appearance.signature: A rectangular wooden seal block carved with Nalanda’s institutional emblem and script, held in his right hand with a short handled clay-ink pad in the left, plus a string-tied bundle of palm-leaf documents tucked under his arm.

ref_desc: Nalanda Seal Keeper: early-forties monk with medium-brown oval face, short black hair and saffron headband, in off-white tunic, saffron robe, full-length dhoti and brown sandals, carrying a wooden seal block, ink pad and palm-leaf bundle in a saffron–off-white–dark brown palette.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body shonen-anime style Nalanda Seal Keeper: an early-forties monk with a medium-brown oval face, calm focused eyes, straight nose and a neatly trimmed short beard, short black hair held by a saffron cloth headband knotted at the back. He wears an off-white long-sleeved cotton tunic fully covering his torso, wrapped with a saffron sanghati robe draped from left shoulder across the chest and around the waist, plus a full-length unbleached cotton dhoti-style wrap skirt to the ankles and simple dark brown leather sandals. A narrow dark red sash at his waist holds a small cloth pouch at his right hip. In his right hand he presents a rectangular wooden seal block carved with an emblem and script; in his left he holds a short handled ink pad used for sealing. Under one arm is a neatly tied bundle of palm-leaf documents with visible string. Use a palette dominated by saffron, off-white, dark brown and dark red, and show him standing in a neutral pose so costume, face, hair and seal tools are clearly visible head to toe.
